sections.text: Architecture review checks that signal producers and consumers refer to declared components, interface units agree, and dependency targets exist. Flagged findings are candidates requiring human review.

Default question answering uses only the current revision in the selected project. Historical revisions must be explicitly selected. Revision comparison reports changed sections without automatic approval.
The assistant is a synthetic demonstrator. It cannot certify AUTOSAR compliance or approve safety, security or production design decisions. All outputs require an engineering reviewer.
